points.description: States the core idea: repeatedly find the minimum element among the remaining (unsorted) elements and swap it into the current position (moving left to right).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only 'finds the minimum/smallest' or only 'swaps into place' is stated, or the idea is vague or has a minor error.

points.description: States that it processes one element/position at a time from left to right, with the minimum chosen from the remaining elements after the current one.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of 'left to right' or 'remaining elements' is mentioned.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the idea of repeatedly selecting the minimum of the remaining elements and swapping it with the current element; wording may differ. Give part marks for a half-stated or vague version (e.g. only 'finds the smallest element' with no swap). Give no marks for descriptions of other sorts (e.g. swapping adjacent elements or inserting into a sorted part) or generic 'it sorts the array'.
